description: Guild Wars guide covering EX+ meat farming (0B0C/0B1C) and Nightmare boss strategies (NM90 to NM250).

stages.name: Extreme+ (EX+ Meat Farming)
stages.targetClearTime: Sub-3.5 seconds (0-Button or Quick Summon OTK)

coreRequirements: Guaranteed TA party (e.g. Bowman, Seox, Ilsa)
Ereshkigal or Hrunting or Falsehood Opus
meatOptimization.tacticalActionSequence: Press Attack immediately upon battle entry; no skills or summons invoked. Normal attacks + echoes + end-of-turn nukes defeat boss in 2.8 seconds.

coreRequirements: High Ougi supplemental (Fediel Spine / Galleon Jaw)
meatOptimization.tacticalActionSequence: Press Attack; frontline 1st character Ougis and deals massive single-hit cap-breaking damage.

coreRequirements: Beelzebub / Triple Zero set as Quick Summon
meatOptimization.tacticalActionSequence: Click Quick Summon button -> Press Attack. Beelzebub deals 3M plain damage + 40% DEF down + Bore; normal attacks clean up remaining HP.

bossTriggers: 75% Trigger: Deals multi-hit damage and inflicts DEF Down / Blind
50% Trigger: Buff wipe and gains 50% Damage Cut barrier
recommendedFullAutoRoster: High single-turn burst units (Percival, Narmaya, Nehan, Ilsa)
survivalInterlocks: Ensure Dispel available to immediately clear 50% damage cut buff to avoid turn stalls.
nightmareStrategies.notes: Target sub-20 second clears with 1-turn burst setups or fast 2-turn Full Auto.

bossTriggers: 85% Trigger: Deals 25,000 plain damage and inflicts Strong Poison / Skill Seal
50% Trigger: Strips all party buffs, clears boss debuffs, gains 100% TA and Unchallenged
35% Trigger: Deals 40,000 multi-hit elemental damage and inflicts Paralyze
15% Trigger: Fatal lethal strike (bypasses standard cuts)
recommendedFullAutoRoster: Auto-cleanse / auto-heal anchors (Satyr, Haaselia, Horus, Lich, Cosmos)
Frequent end-of-turn dispels to purge 50% Unchallenged barrier
Damage mitigation tanks (Poseidon, Anne, Vira, Seox)
survivalInterlocks: Zombified Safety Interlock: Potion/heal commands MUST be locked if 85% trigger inflicts Zombified.
Mandatory 2+ dispels queued for 50% trigger to eliminate Unchallenged before main attacks.
nightmareStrategies.notes: Optimal honor-per-meat conversion efficiency for players with refined FA rosters.

bossTriggers: 90% Trigger: Omen (Requires 40 hits or 4 Charge Attacks to cancel)
70% Trigger: Boss gains Absolute Barrier (100,000 per hit limit) and Reflect
50% Trigger: Massive plain damage nuke, full buff strip, inflicts Petrified (4 turns)
20% Trigger: Enters Berserk stance; normal attacks hit all 4 party members simultaneously
recommendedFullAutoRoster: Transcendence Lucifer 250 (Main/Friend) for 50% max HP and auto-cleanse on specials
Dual sustain buffers with revive fail-safes (Haaselia, Yuni, Horus, Fediel)
Defense-awakened Revans weapons (Sette di Spade / Schrodinger / Extinction Blade)
survivalInterlocks: Reflect / 100% Cut Halt: Pause normal attack queues when 70% Reflect buff is present without Dispel.
Lucifer 250 Turn-1 call or Quick Summon to maintain Wings of Pure White refresh.
nightmareStrategies.notes: Crew coordination stage; solo FA requires 70k+ HP pool and defense-awakened weapon grids.
